name: weyl_gate.py
mathematical_scope: Exact finite-field radix-2 NTT and one-sided randomized Weyl test. For a fixed linear endomorphism independent of probes, two exact intertwining identities characterize a Fourier scalar and one calibration entry fixes the scalar. Includes O(n)-apply precomputed tridiagonal Green sums/products.
input_and_guard_coverage: Root guard supports powers of two 2..2^23 dividing P-1; Tonelli-Shanks rejects nonsquares. trials>=1, matching LU lengths and nonzero unpivoted pivots checked. Missing n validation before base[0], oracle output lengths/types/canonical residues, linearity/fixed-state assumption enforcement, nonempty Green terms/stages, valid permutation/gauge sizes and empty-solver handling.
costs: NTT O(n log n) field operations/O(n) storage. LU O(n) inversions at setup, O(n) solve/storage. q terms × t stages cost O(qtn) per apply and storage O(qtn), plus phase generation and permutation construction. Weyl test costs (1+3 trials) oracle calls plus O(trials*n), not full coefficient verification.
test_evidence: Companion suite covers defaults and several adversaries but not oracle contract/shape or public constructor edge cases. No supplied tests run.
acceptance_boundary: Probability bound P^-trials needs a fixed linear map and fresh independent uniform field probes. Finite-field passing is not a complex identity. Independent global randomness with seed=None is intended; fixed seed has no claimed adversarial soundness guarantee in docstring.
findings: L119–120 zip silently truncates mismatched outputs. A stateful oracle can give calibrated base, normal-length out, and empty mz/md, yielding zero mismatches. This is outside the needed fixed-linear endomorphism contract but the API does not reject it.
L125 always returns an independent-uniform bound string even with a fixed seed, despite L101–103 disclaimer.

L139–150 permits build of empty LU but solve then indexes b[0]. L174/L183 index first elements of possibly empty lists. Unpivoted zero-pivot rejection is documented and must not be misread as a singularity proof.
